data.source_title: Challenges in Preanalytical Phase of Laboratory Medicine: Rate of Blood Sample Nonconformity in a Tertiary Care Hospital
data.source_setting: Shalamar Hospital, 430-bed teaching hospital, Lahore, Pakistan; hematology and chemical pathology
data.quantity: Observed preanalytical error fraction among received samples
data.source_evidence_basis: Original journal PDF, Methods and Results: retrospective 2018 review found 1,688 preanalytical errors among 113,817 received hematology and chemical-pathology samples (1.48%). This is an observed single-center fraction.
data.limitations: Single hospital and only hematology/chemical pathology blood samples; data are from 2018 and may reflect local collection and logging practices. Not RWJ performance or an ED-specific rate.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use as an external reference point for a scenario with specimen accept/reject decision and recollection consequences; keep any local rejection probability uncalibrated until RWJ data are acquired.
data.retrieval_timestamp_precision: day; time not logged during source inspection, midnight is a date placeholder

provenance.acquisition_method: limited factual paraphrase; inspect record-level source_access and inspected_source_url for retrieval scope; source location retained

data.source_title: Challenges in Preanalytical Phase of Laboratory Medicine: Rate of Blood Sample Nonconformity in a Tertiary Care Hospital
data.source_setting: Shalamar Hospital, Lahore; hospital blood specimens
data.quantity: Most frequent rejection/error categories as share of errors
data.source_evidence_basis: Original journal PDF, Table 1: among 1,688 recorded errors, 604 were unlabeled (35.8%); other leading categories were clotting (14.9%), dilution (11.8%), and wrong record number (10.2%). Shares use recorded errors as denominator.
data.limitations: Category shares are conditional on recorded errors, not all samples. The supplied table excerpt does not quantify all listed criteria, and this distribution is not transferable as a local mix without validation.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent specimen lifecycle states (collected, labeled, transported, received, accepted/rejected, recollection pending, resulted) and rejection reason; do not sample category proportions from this single-center mix as RWJ facts.
